name: RegIntel-MCP
summary: FDA docket retrieval, comment-corpus export and draft-to-final guidance comparison for regulatory RWE research.
capabilities: Search dockets and retrieve documents, comments and attachment text
Build and export cached comment corpora
Compare draft and final guidance by section; companion skills support human-reviewed thematic and concordance analysis
limitation: Requires a Regulations.gov API key and local cache. Concordance does not establish that comments caused guidance changes. Interpretation belongs to companion skills with human checkpoints. Server MIT; explorer separately PolyForm Noncommercial. Static documentation review only; code was not installed or executed.

relevance.rationale: FDA docket retrieval, comment-corpus export and draft-to-final guidance comparison for regulatory RWE research.
relevance.relevanceBasis: FDA docket retrieval, comment-corpus export and draft-to-final guidance comparison for regulatory RWE research.

name: Reg4RWE
summary: Study-design appraisal against regulatory precedents drawn from public FDA reviews and EMA assessment reports.
capabilities: appraise_rwe_design returns relevant precedents and recorded regulatory feedback
Companion skill guides appraisal from retrieved precedents
Hosted navigator and HTTP action provide additional access to the corpus
limitation: Some corpus records are marked Needs manual review. Precedent retrieval does not establish regulatory acceptance of a proposed design. Documentation states appraisal design text and returned precedents are logged; review data handling before submitting confidential designs. Unaffiliated with Black Swan Causal Labs. Static documentation review only; code was not installed or executed.
